title: Pipeline
description:
Runs an image through several effects in one request, each step working on the result of the one before. A step is an object with the effect's name as op and that effect's parameters next to it, for example {"op": "pixelate", "palette": "gameboy"}. Every effect of the Image Manipulation endpoints that takes one image and returns one is available as a step; effects that return an animation can only be the last step.

Available as steps: pixelate, pixelsort, retro, ascii, glitch, jpeg, emojimosaic, lego, magik, bulge, swirl, bighead, blurfaces, smartcrop, pat, shake and spin.
